g.text: Most of the score is scale and contiguity

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'Hiragino Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #334155

g.text: Self-containment split into what the sizes of the areas give (random relabelling), what any contiguous zoning of those sizes adds (recombination

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'Hiragino Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #334155

g.text: chain) and what the position of the boundaries adds.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'Hiragino Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #64748b

g.text: Recombination chain: 100 samples after burn-in, area sizes within 5 % of the partition's. ONS coding: people who work at home, offshore or with no fixed place counted at their residence.
